about: The public keys of the URTC family, where each one is embedded and where its private half lives. Only public values and file names are written here; no secret ever is. tools/keys.py verify reads every embedding and fails when one differs from the value below.

keys.role: Signs every asset of an official release (the .sig files); the flasher, the web studio and the publishing tool check it before they trust a download.
keys.private_half: Outside every repository (the file named by URTC_RELEASE_KEY, by default ~/.urtc-keys/urtc_release_ed25519.pem) and, if the maintainer chooses, the secret URTC_RELEASE_ED25519_PEM of the protected release environment.

keys.role: The PUBLIC development key of the main bootloader: images built without a production key are signed with it, so they prove nothing about who made them. A production build replaces it with a key that is not in any repository.
keys.private_half: None: this one is published on purpose. The production key of the main bootloader is a secret in ~/.urtc-keys/signing_keys.txt (line master=) and in the secret URTC_SIGNING_KEYS of the release environment; it is never written to a file of a repository.

keys.role: The PUBLIC development key of the expansion slave bootloader (same rule as the main one).
keys.private_half: None for this one. The production key of the slave bootloader is the line slave= of the same secret file.

secrets_not_stored_here: The production HMAC keys of the two bootloaders (master= and slave=).
The private half of the release signature key.
